_about: Allowlist of the leftover-name gate (scripts/check-brand.mjs): the counted places where the previous product name (ZabsReel) or Relo may appear.

Each entry: the file, the allowed text (regex alternatives, or literal strings matched exactly; case-sensitive unless flags is "i"), the gate patterns that text may contain, the recorded match count, and the reason.
A count that differs from the scan fails the gate. `node scripts/check-brand.mjs --counts` prints the counts it finds; record a new count only after checking that every match is a legitimate mention.
